What we fix and set up

Everything a small business needs to keep its computers and network running.

  • Computer setup

    New PCs and laptops configured, with accounts, printers, and your business software ready to use.

  • Software installation

    Operating system, office apps, antivirus, and POS or inventory software installed and updated.

  • Troubleshooting and repair

    Slow computers, errors, printer problems, and basic hardware faults diagnosed and fixed.

  • Network and WiFi

    Router and LAN setup, WiFi coverage checks, and connection problems solved.

  • Regular maintenance

    Scheduled check-ups, updates, and cleanups so small problems are caught before they stop your business.
